Name: Qi Chests
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Qi Chests[/b] adds color coded chest networks, derived from junimo chests. (Like a certain Ender Chest mod for Minecraft.)

To turn a junimo chest into a qi chest, hold Left Shift and open it. To turn it back into a junimo chest, break the chest and pick it up.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install SpaceCore.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and (probably) multiplayer.
